integrity_statement: The full 21-point projective-plane subset space is exhaustively examined by a supplied standalone recurrence checker. The original parity-check construction and classical projective facts are attributed to their sources. Mathematical novelty beyond accessible literature remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to three global checks, quaternary projectively distinct columns, and seven through twenty-one pair groups; minimizing subset counts are not code-equivalence counts. Prior hyperoval classification is not claimed as new. Independent assessment is not performed.
title: Sharp minimum-weight multiplicities for rank-three quaternary paired-locality codes
